high_level_description: The image is a comic strip that humorously illustrates the concept of futurism and its predictions about future changes. The title at the top reads "THE LAW OF FUTUROLOGY: y-t = 0," where: \( y \) represents the approximate number of years left in the life of a futurist. \( t \) represents the years the futurist thinks it will be until immortality is discovered. Below the title, there are three panels with different characters expressing their views on how things will change. Left Panel: A young man with red hair is standing against a green background
